local_provider_description: Authenticate users with an email address and password stored in Obot. No external identity provider required.
local_provider_domains_description: Comma-separated list of email domains that local users may have. Use * to allow any domain.
okta_client_id_setup: Client ID of an Okta API Services app, which Obot uses to fetch each user's groups from the Okta Management API when they sign in. Leave this and the private key empty to provision users and groups through SCIM instead.
okta_private_key_setup: PEM-encoded RSA private key of the Okta API Services app. Leave this and the client ID empty to provision users and groups through SCIM instead.
okta_parameter_unused: Not used: Okta provisions users and groups through SCIM, so Obot no longer calls the Okta Management API. You can remove it, then delete the API Services app in Okta.
provider_only_one: only one authentication provider can be configured at a time. Please deconfigure {provider} first
local_user_exists: a local user with that email already exists
local_not_authenticated: the current user is not authenticated with the local provider
local_no_password_change: the current local user does not require a password change
local_password_completed: password setup has already been completed or the session is no longer valid
local_unavailable: the local auth provider is not available because authentication is disabled
provider_cleanup_pending: authentication provider {provider} is still being deconfigured; wait for cleanup to finish before configuring it again
provider_deconfigure_active: deconfiguring {provider} would leave no way to sign in. Configure a replacement and complete the switch instead
provider_staged_replacement: {provider} is staged as a replacement. Discard the staged switch instead
provider_already_active: {provider} is already the active authentication provider
provider_verify_first: sign in through {provider} to verify it before completing the switch
local_valid_email_required: a valid email address is required
local_email_domain_disallowed: email {email} is not in the provider's allowed email domains
local_initial_owner_role: the initial local account must become Owner; choose an email that is not configured as an Admin through the environment
local_password_must_differ: the new password must be different from your current password
local_setup_token_length: the initial owner setup token must be at least 32 characters
local_initial_owner_domain: initial owner email {email} is not in the local provider's allowed email domains
local_password_min_length: password must be at least {count} characters
local_bootstrap_limit: bootstrap can only create one local account; sign in with the existing account to continue setup
provider_change_in_progress: another provider configuration change is already in progress
setup_no_provider_user_id: no auth provider user ID in context
setup_local_not_configured: local authentication is not the configured provider
setup_no_local_account: no local account exists for setup
setup_sign_in_initial: sign in with the initial local account to continue setup
setup_change_password: change your password before completing setup
setup_email_mismatch: email mismatch: expected {expected} but got {actual} in request
setup_cannot_promote_admin: cannot promote {email} to Owner: the address is configured as an Admin through the environment
